testy.meta_title: Cybersecurity tests for companies by industry — subenai
testy.meta_description: Phishing, fraudulent SMS and online scams — cybersecurity tests for e-shops, gastro, IT, auto repair and other industries. Test your whole team.
testy.og_description: Phishing, fraudulent SMS and online scams — cybersecurity tests for e-shops, gastro, IT, auto repair and other industries.
testy.page_intro: Phishing in an e-shop looks different from vishing in a call center, a fake invoice in accounting different from a suspicious courier SMS. Pick the question set you actually meet at work — and find your blind spots. 5 minutes, no signup, results right away.
testy.learning_strip_subheading: Short articles from the academy — context for what you'll recognize in the test.
testy.learning_strip_empty_hint: No tagged articles yet — coming soon.
testy.faq_subheading: The 5 questions we get most often from first-time visitors. Click a question to expand the answer.
testy.faq_a1: Yes, completely. No signup, no credit card, no paywall. The project is funded by voluntary support — if it helped you, you can support it at /support.
testy.faq_a2: 5–10 minutes depending on the pack. The standard test has 15 questions, industry packs 8–25. You can close the test at any time and start over.
testy.faq_a3: For anyone working on the internet — from students and seniors to IT teams and company management. Industry tests (e-shop, gastro, IT, auto repair…) measure exactly what you meet in practice.
testy.faq_a4: We store only anonymized answers and scores — no name, email or IP. After the test you get a unique link that you can share without your results being traceable back to you.
testy.faq_q5: Can I send the test to colleagues?
testy.faq_a5: Yes — send them a link to a specific pack (e.g. /tests/eshop) or build your own using the composer at /test/builder. Each person gets their own anonymous result.

skolenia.meta_description: Free cybersecurity courses: phishing, vishing, smishing, online scams, data protection. Real examples from the Slovak environment.
skolenia.og_description: Free cybersecurity courses: phishing, vishing, smishing, online scams. Real examples from the Slovak environment.
skolenia.page_heading: Free courses in 5 topics — phishing, vishing, smishing, fake e-shops, investment scams.
skolenia.page_intro: Each course is a 10-minute page with real examples from the Slovak internet — no 60-page PDFs. For yourself, for colleagues, for parents. After every topic we'll also recommend a blog article if you want to go deeper.
skolenia.value_real_desc: Actual scams from the Slovak web
skolenia.faq_subheading: The 5 questions we get most often about free courses. Click a question to expand the answer.
skolenia.faq_a1: No. All courses are completely free. No signup, no credit card, no email. The project is funded by voluntary support at /support.
skolenia.faq_q2: How long does one course take?
skolenia.faq_a2: 5–20 minutes depending on the topic. Each is a short page with real examples — not a 60-page PDF. You can skim it in 5 minutes or read it thoroughly.
skolenia.faq_a3: No — no certificates, no LMS, no tracking. The goal is to actually learn to spot a scam, not to hang a paper on the wall. To check what stuck, take a test at /test.
skolenia.faq_a4: For anyone working with email, phone or the internet — from students and seniors to IT teams and HR. No prerequisites. Real examples, Slovak texts, no corporate jargon.
skolenia.faq_q5: Can I send a course to colleagues or parents?
skolenia.faq_a5: Yes. Send them a link to a specific course (e.g. /courses/email-phishing). It opens without signup and they can return any time — courses don't expire and are free forever.
